chapter_seo_title: RMJI Ch 342: Han Li's Terrifying Interrogation - Mastering the Soul Refining Bluff
chapter_meta_description: The tables turn as Han Li interrogates the soul possessing Qu Hun. Using a mistaken identity and the fearsome Soul-Gathering Bowl, he unleashes a terrifying psychological assault to break his captive's will. No punches pulled.
og_title: The False Confession: Han Li Masters Intimidation
og_description: Watch a master of psychological warfare at work. Han Li weaponizes a deadly rumor to break a possessed soul without a single true spell. Pure Mortal Stream efficiency.
twitter_title: Han Li's Scariest Trick Isn't a Spell
twitter_description: Han Li doesn't need magic to terrify you—just a bowl, a rumor, and absolute silence. This chapter is a masterclass in intimidating your enemies into submission.

lore_anchors.definition: A magical tool intimately connected to the body it was refined from. Holding it grants the wielder control over that body's actions.
A forbidden, cruel art that extracts a cultivator's primordial soul and tortures it. Considered the worst possible punishment in the cultivation world.
A unique magical tool connected to its user's primordial soul, required to perform the Soul Refining Technique. Its presence is enough to inspire terror.
A阴森 magical tool filled with the souls of slain cultivators. Its chilling aura and ghostly wails make it easily mistaken for a Soul Vessel.
The second major realm of cultivation, marking a true cultivator with a lifespan of over 200 years. The possessing soul claims to have once been at this level.
A talisman that can immobilize a low-level cultivator. While it does not block speech or facial expressions, it completely removes their ability to move.
